body:
Prescribing phrases can be added, edited, archived and restored in English and Bahasa Melayu. The four approved kinds are frequency, instruction, precaution and duration. Each language is limited to 60 characters. A different authorized doctor must approve a draft before the later suggestion popup can offer it; editing approved wording returns it to draft. Saved orders retain their text.

The settings page provides search, kind/status filters and pagination. Review suggestions lists diagnoses and phrases with a combined waiting count. The continuation refreshes current main and fixes page-local responsive controls (44px below 1024px, at least 36px on desktop), switch focus/semantic tokens and the add-dialog selector minimum. Page scripts and shared components are unchanged by these target corrections.

Existing catalogue.settings.manage.organisation and clinical_suggestions.approve.organisation permissions are reused. Mutations recheck branch/authority inside transactions with organisation/row locks, lock_version, actor-bound retry hashes and identifier-only audits. The approved migration creates prescribing_phrases and prescribing_phrase_commands; down refuses when rows exist. No new permission or production activation is included.

The two original owner-approved assertion adaptations remain unchanged: combined frontend waiting count and backend draftTotal expectation. No existing test was edited for the responsive correction. The consultation popup itself remains a separate slice.

Validation on the refreshed candidate: 2,209 frontend tests, TypeScript, production build, scoped Pint/PHPStan, UI lint/format and diff checks pass. All 31 affected PostgreSQL Feature-suite tests pass with 445 assertions and a clean exit. An earlier unrestricted suite invocation reported passing cases with duplicate-suite warnings; selecting the intended Feature suite resolved the invocation issue without altering tests. The subsequent main refresh changes upstream documentation only. Independent source review verified all 15 main-relative files, unchanged migration/backend/test blobs, the route union and exact target patch. Coordinator component-browser checks covered 390/768/1440 in both themes, keyboard focus and the mobile add dialog; this synthetic-prop preview is not signed-in end-to-end mutation evidence. Fresh exact-head CI remains required before merge.
